item.title: Wanda-Guided Sparse Perturbations for Efficient Zeroth-Order Optimization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization enables memory-efficient fine-tuning of large language models through forward-only evaluations, but high-dimensional random perturbations can limit optimization efficiency. Sparse perturbations reduce the search dimension, making the selection of informative coordinates critical. We propose Wanda-Importance Sparsity-MeZO (WIS-MeZO), which uses Wanda weight--activation saliency to construct task-conditioned sparse perturbation masks while keeping the pretrained model dense. We analyze support quality through gradient energy capture and relate it to gradient estimation and convergence. Across 16 benchmarks with LLaMA and Qwen models ranging from 3B to 32B parameters, WIS-MeZO achieves higher aggregate scores than MeZO and reaches comparable validation losses in fewer optimization steps. Comparisons with random and magnitude-based sparse perturbations further highlight the importance of informative support selection.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Vector-Space Projection and Unified Complex-Valued Acceleration for Scaling Matrix-Based Brain-Inspired Representations
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Symbolic reasoning at scale requires representations that are both expressive and hardware-efficient. Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) provides a promising brain-inspired framework, encoding concepts as high-dimensional vectors composed through efficient algebraic operations. However, the widely used Fourier Holographic Reduced Representation (FHRR) relies on commutative binding, which cannot encode order or directionality. Prior FPGA/ASIC accelerators recover this through costly permutation logic, incurring irregular memory access and high control overhead. Generalized Holographic Reduced Representations (GHRR) instead redefine binding as non-commutative matrix multiplication, naturally encoding sequences, graphs, and hierarchies without permutations-but at the cost of turning every element into a matrix, introducing compute and storage overhead that limits scalability. In this work, we propose a flattening methodology that preserves GHRR's matrix-based encoding while executing training and inference directly in vector space, functionally equivalent to FHRR inference yet free of permutation logic. We further design a custom 28 nm ASIC that fuses binding and similarity into a unifi…

item.title: Using an energy pixels approach to estimate the size a 2nd Generation DEL must be to train a high-resolution binding model
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

DNA-encoded libraries (DELs) are commonly used to find small-molecule binders to a target protein. But the hard part is no longer finding a hit. It is building a machine-learning model good enough to guide the medicinal chemistry that follows, one that can resolve the shift in affinity when a chemist changes a single atom. Such a model needs two things from its training data: dense sampling of the small patch of chemical space around the hit, and an adequate number of genuinely tight binders within it. A diverse naive DEL gives neither. It samples an enormous space, so any one neighborhood is covered far too thinly, and the tightest binders are rare. A model trained on that naive DEL data must extrapolate to binders tighter than any it has seen, and that is where models can fail. One way to get training data with both properties is a second-generation DEL built around the hit. We ask how complex that library must be. We treat binding as a sum of small, independent interactions, called pixels on the target and antipixels on the ligand. From the spread of affinities measured in the naive library, with no structural information and nothing yet synthesized, we estimate the complexity s…

item.title: Two mathematical models of knowledge distillation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Many hypotheses compete to explain the successes of knowledge distillation. To help address this, we propose and analyze a mathematical model of distillation, which suggests that distillation's performance comes not from obtaining better models but from easier to optimize landscapes. For generalized linear models trained with stochastic gradient descent, we prove that distillation fits performant student models asymptotically more quickly than non-distilled models. In rank-1 matrix approximation, we characterize conditions on the target matrix under which gradient descent with distillation converges strictly faster than training on the supervised objective. The theory helps delineate the ways distillation provides benefits (i.e., in optimization speed, not in generalization), and experiments on real datasets corroborate the theoretical predictions.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Towards Automated Recommendation of Steady-State Detection Algorithms for Software Performance Benchmarks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Steady-state detection is a central step in software performance benchmarking, yet different detection methods rely on different assumptions and may perform best on different execution profiles. This paper formulates steady-state detection as an algorithm-recommendation problem: given a benchmark time series, predict which of two complementary detectors is more appropriate. The first, CP-SSD, identifies steady state through changepoint-based segmentation of the execution trace, whereas the second, KB-KSSD, uses a kernel-based approach to identify stable behaviour. We propose a data-driven recommender that characterises benchmark time series using automatically extracted features and combines supervised prediction with information derived from groups of time series exhibiting similar behaviour. The approach is evaluated on 407 labelled benchmark time series for which one of the two detectors can be identified as preferable with respect to a reference steady-state index. The proposed recommender selects the better detector correctly for 72.97% of the series, compared with 62.65% when always selecting the detector that performs best most often, corresponding to an absolute improvement…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Time Flies When You Parallelise: Pareto-efficient Time Series Foundation Models with Linear Recurrences
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Time series foundation models have demonstrated strong zero-shot forecasting performance, but computational efficiency remains a central architectural challenge. Temporal self-attention incurs quadratic cost in the number of temporal tokens, while nonlinear recurrent state transitions restrict parallel computation along the temporal dimension. We introduce ci-proto, a family of time series foundation models based on Mamba-3, whose linear state recurrences support chunk-wise parallel-in-time computation during training, and inference costs that scale linearly with sequence length. The architecture alternates recurrent temporal processing with cross-variate attention, supporting multivariate probabilistic forecasting with past-only and future-known covariates. Across fev-bench's 100 forecasting tasks, ci-proto XL sets a new state of the art among time series foundation models. The five ci-proto variants also make up the entire Pareto frontier for mean scaled quantile loss and mean absolute scaled error against both parameter count and median runtime.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Theoretical and Empirical Analysis of Sparse Convolution
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Deep neural networks for image processing are increasingly deployed on resource-constrained edge devices such as drones, medical systems, and smartphones, where limited computational resources and memory bandwidth pose significant challenges for efficient inference. Pruning during training often produces highly sparse convolutional kernels, offering the potential to significantly reduce computation and memory requirements. However, exploiting this sparsity efficiently at runtime remains challenging due to irregular memory access patterns and workload imbalance across processing elements. In this work, we investigate the standard convolution with sparse weights and analyze its performance characteristics through roofline analysis, showing that a 3 x 3 sparse convolution achieves an arithmetic intensity of approximately 10 FLOP/byte compared to roughly 96 FLOP/byte for its dense counterpart. We propose techniques for an efficient sparse convolution at high sparsities. Preliminary results demonstrate that our approach achieves upto 1.65x speedup as compared to dense convolution on NVIDIA A100 and upto 1.52x on NVIDIA Jetson Nano (Tegra X1) , motivating further exploration of direct co…

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Sustainable Federated Fine-Tuning with LoRA: Environmental Impact and Performance Footprint
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Federated Learning (FL) with Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) enables efficient adaptation of Large Language Models (LLMs), yet its energy and carbon costs across hardware remain poorly understood. We evaluated federated Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) fine-tuning on NVIDIA A40, RTX 6000 Ada, and A100 GPUs using a $2^2$ full factorial design with 135M/360M models and 10/100 local steps. CodeCarbon tracked energy and estimated CO$_2$-equivalent emissions. Descriptive allocation of variation assigned 84.8-91.2% of energy and emissions variation to local steps within these ranges. On A40 and RTX 6000 Ada, configurations with fewer steps achieved comparable accuracy with roughly 6-8-fold lower energy consumption and higher accuracy per kWh. These findings support smaller local budgets for energy-efficient federated fine-tuning within the evaluated setting.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: SoScale: Second-Order Scale Search for FP4 Quantization
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：FP4 量化（MXFP4/NVFP4/HiF4）精度高度依赖局部分布如何缩放；默认 max-abs scaling 把稀缺 FP4 电平花在罕见离群区，密集张量值解析不足；现有 scale-search 优化张量保真而非层输出保真。

方法：SoScale 二阶权重 scale-code 搜索：在 Hessian-aware 层重构目标下搜索硬件有效 scale code，并与 GPTQ 风格误差恢复耦合，按对层输出的影响选择 scale。

关键数字：Qwen3 系列上 MXFP4/NVFP4/HiF4 三种格式一致降低下游量化退化（abstract 未给具体数值）。

为什么值得看：FP4 量化 scale 选择的目标函数改进，直接提升低比特推理精度。

item.title: Snoopie: A Multi-GPU Communication Profiler and Visualizer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：数据移动成为最贵的扩展瓶颈，但现有剖析工具擅长单 GPU 计算，对 GPU-GPU 数据传输与通信库调用的监测不足。

方法：Snoopie 基于 NVBit 的插桩式多 GPU 通信剖析工具，跟踪 peer-to-peer 传输与 GPU-centric 通信库调用；把数据移动归因到源码行与数据对象；提供从系统整体到具体指令/地址的多粒度可视化。

关键数字：工具开源：https://github.com/ParCoreLab/snoopie（abstract 未给量化性能数字）。

为什么值得看：填补多 GPU 通信剖析空白，直接服务多卡应用调试与性能定位。

原文：Snoopie: A Multi-GPU Communication Profiler and Visualizer

item.title: Smoothed Analysis for Distributed MIS
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

We study smoothed analysis of the distributed Maximal Independent Set (MIS) problem. Luby's algorithm computes an MIS in $O(\log n)$ rounds, while the recent $Ω(\log n/\log\log n)$ lower bound of Khoury and Schild (2026) shows that it is nearly optimal even in the LOCAL model. We ask whether small random perturbations can overcome this worst-case barrier. Given an arbitrary base graph $G$ on $n$ nodes, we consider the smoothed graph $\mathcal{G}_s=G\triangle G(n,p)$, where $G(n,p)$ is an independent random graph and $\triangle$ denotes symmetric difference. Thus, each possible edge is independently toggled with probability $p$. We establish nearly tight bounds on the smoothing needed for faster distributed MIS. For every base graph $G$, when $p=β\ln n/n$ for a sufficiently large constant $β$, a randomized LOCAL algorithm, given only $\mathcal{G}_s$, computes an MIS of $\mathcal{G}_s$ in $O(\sqrt{\log n})$ rounds with high probability. This is almost quadratically faster than the worst-case lower bound. Conversely, if $p\le(1/2-δ)\ln n/n$ for a fixed constant $δ>0$, there exists a base graph on which every randomized LOCAL MIS algorithm requires $Ω(\log n/\log\log n)$ rounds on the …

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Self-Supervised Attention-Based Virtual Metrology for CMP MRR Prediction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Chemical mechanical planarization (CMP) is a critical semiconductor manufacturing process where material removal rate (MRR) is a key metric for process monitoring and advanced process control (APC). Virtual metrology enables MRR estimation from process time series signals, supporting run-to-run(R2R) control and process optimization while reducing reliance on physical metrology. Existing approaches typically rely on simplified linear assumptions or require handcrafted feature engineering. In this paper, we propose Global Regression Pretraining(GREP), a self-supervised, attention-based framework for CMP MRR prediction. GREP learns temporal representations from unlabeled sensor signals through global proxy-target regression, followed by supervised fine-tuning for MRR estimation. The framework is evaluated against a feature-engineered supervised baseline under three conditions: limited labeled data, sensor noise, and temporal process drift. Experiments on the PHM 2016 CMP dataset demonstrate competitive performance under limited labeled-data conditions, with improvements in selected cases and performance largely comparable to the baseline across different labeled-data fractions. item.title: SS-HSDP: Efficient and Flexible Sharded Data Parallelism via Runtime-Update Decoupling
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Sharded data parallelism enables memory-efficient training of large models. While efficient training kernels favor packed, kernel-specific data layouts, optimizers may require variant data structures as optimization units. Existing sharded data-parallel frameworks couple these two choices, limiting runtime efficiency and optimization flexibility. To address this, we present \textbf{\our}, a training framework that separates runtime parameters from update parameters, allowing computation layouts and optimization units to be organized independently. Through shared data views and hierarchical sharding, \our supports this separation while avoiding redundant data movement. This design supports a broad range of optimizers, including matrix-based methods such as Muon, and performance optimizations such as fully zero-copy execution. Experiments on video and language model workloads with MXFP8 training show that \our achieves higher Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) than FSDP2, veScale-FSDP, and Megatron-FSDP. At 128 GPUs, MFU improves by up to 21.7\% over the fastest evaluated baseline, with comparable or lower peak memory usage.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.content:encoded:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Sharded data parallelism enables memory-efficient training of large models. While efficient training kernels favor packed, kernel-specific data layouts, optimizers may require variant data structures as optimization units. Existing sharded data-parallel frameworks couple these two choices, limiting runtime efficiency and optimization flexibility. To address this, we present \textbf{\our}, a training framework that separates runtime parameters from update parameters, allowing computation layouts and optimization units to be organized independently. Through shared data views and hierarchical sharding, \our supports this separation while avoiding redundant data movement. This design supports a broad range of optimizers, including matrix-based methods such as Muon, and performance optimizations such as fully zero-copy execution. Experiments on video and language model workloads with MXFP8 training show that \our achieves higher Model FLOPs Utilization (MFU) than FSDP2, veScale-FSDP, and Megatron-FSDP. At 128 GPUs, MFU improves by up to 21.7\% over the fastest evaluated baseline, with comparable or lower peak memory usage.

item.title: SPEC CPU2026 Under the Microscope: Programs, Phases, and Samples
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

SPEC CPU2026, the latest generation of the SPEC CPU benchmarks, is set to become the standard benchmark suite in computer architecture research, where new designs are often evaluated through sampled simulation with tools such as SimPoint. Existing characterizations of the suite focus on whole-run averages, which reveal neither how behavior changes within a run nor how well sampling captures it. We characterize CPU2026 on real hardware at three levels: programs, phases, and samples. At the program level, we report whole-run metrics and top-down bottleneck classes for all four suites and examine how they change with workload size, compiler version, and platform, across machines with three different instruction set architectures: x86, Arm, and RISC-V. Notably, changing only the compiler version can halve or nearly double the IPC of individual benchmarks. At the phase level, we track hardware counters every 10 ms over all 90 SPECrate inputs, identify recurring patterns of time-varying behavior, and divide the inputs into three groups: steady, multi-phase, and bursty. item.title: SBA: A Practical Memory Performance Denial-of-Service Attack
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Modern cloud platforms use memory bandwidth regulation to isolate co-located workloads, implicitly assuming that high aggregate bandwidth consumption implies high interference. We show that this assumption is fundamentally flawed. We present the Single-Bank Attack (SBA), a practical memory denial-of-service attack that induces extreme cross-core slowdowns---over three orders of magnitude on memory-intensive victims (e.g., LLM decode)---while consuming less than 1 GB/s of memory bandwidth. SBA exploits the gap between peak and worst-case DRAM throughput by concentrating memory write operations on a single bank, forcing persistent row conflicts and frequent write draining, thereby collapsing the memory service rate. Across Intel and AMD systems, including DDR5- and HBM2E-based platforms, SBA consistently causes orders-of-magnitude slowdowns under realistic multi-tenant settings, revealing a fundamental limitation of bandwidth-centric memory isolation. We further show that this localized contention propagates system-wide: single-bank congestion saturates memory controller queues and induces back-pressure into shared cache and coherence structures, ultimately throttling memory request …

item.title: Reducing Batch Makespan for LLM Agent Workloads through Inference-Environment Coordination
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Efficient batch execution of agent tasks is critical to LLM training and development workflows, including benchmark evaluation, synthetic-data generation, and RL rollouts. Since these tasks alternate between LLM inference and environment interaction, we present coordinated optimizations to reduce batch makespan, the time required to complete all tasks in a batch. For hybrid LLMs, a workload-based resource model guides GPU-memory allocation between key-value (KV) cache and recurrent state and provides a reference sample concurrency to exploit parallelism while limiting recomputation. Trajectory-aware routing and scheduling promote cache reuse while balancing worker load. Under constrained environment capacity, we decouple sample admission from environment execution and introduce Chain-Advancing Action Scheduling (CAAS), which prioritizes long chains using observed progress to shorten the batch tail. Controlled replay combines actual inference with recorded environment responses and durations for ablations of individual optimizations. Live evaluations with Ling-3.0-Flash and Ling-3.1-Flash on the BFCL, SWE-bench Multilingual, WideSearch, and MCP-Atlas benchmarks demonstrate makespan …

item.title: Recursive State-Augmented Language Models: Persistent Latent-State Adaptation of Pretrained Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Language models rely on finite token contexts, limiting access to earlier interactions. We introduce Recursive State-Augmented Language Models (Recursive SALM), a framework in which a persistent latent state evolves with each observation and generates adaptations of a pretrained language model. A modular read-transition-write architecture separates observation encoding, latent dynamics, and predictor adaptation. We develop deterministic and stochastic formulations. The experiments evaluate only deterministic SALM with frozen GPT-2 small and exclude earlier evidence from its decoder context. On a four-turn hypothesis-inference task, latent-gated LoRA reaches 89.1% accuracy, comparable to 88.0% for a trained full-context LoRA baseline, with earlier evidence available solely through a 64-dimensional state. Zeroing or shuffling the state substantially reduces accuracy. In a two-turn task with codewords unseen in training, several interfaces improve candidate ranking over chance, but rarely generate the exact codeword under the evaluated training schedule. These experiments show that persistent latent-conditioned adaptation can support sequential inference when earlier evidence is absen…

item.title: Rectified Looped Transformer
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Looped Transformers increase effective depth by repeatedly applying a shared block, offering a parameter-efficient approach to language modeling. However, most existing works directly reuse each loop's output as the next's input, which can lead to hidden-state scale growth and perturbation amplification as recurrence deepens. We propose Rectified Looped Transformer (RLT), which redesigns feedback between loops using an interpolation schedule inspired by flow-based modeling. At each loop, RLT forms the next input by linearly interpolating between the current state and its prediction. Such interpolation distributes state changes across loops, encouraging a smoother trajectory from the initial input to the final output. Theoretical analysis proves that, under appropriate assumptions, RLT keeps state magnitudes uniformly bounded across loops and reduces the worst-case perturbation amplification. We evaluate RLT on language modeling corpora and downstream benchmarks. At matched training and inference depths, RLT consistently achieves lower perplexity than a standard looped Transformer, while exhibiting greater robustness to input perturbations and variance in inference depth. Consistent…

item.title: RESYNC: Residual Latent-State Synchronization for Deadline-Bound Streaming Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Predicting every observation in a high-rate stream requires a model to finish before the next arrival. A large model may offer better predictions but miss that deadline. We propose RESYNC: the large model runs asynchronously, while a fast path updates its latest exact but stale latent state using the observations received since that state was computed and applies its unchanged prediction head. The updater learns from the frozen model's representations without task labels. Across one real and two synthetic streams and five architecture families, RESYNC beats the best compact or distilled alternative with a paired 95% interval above zero in all twelve dataset--architecture pairs with a material teacher advantage at anchor ages of 4--12 observations, and in eleven pairs at older tested ages up to 32. The share of the teacher's gain preserved remains complete on the real stream but is lower and generally declines with anchor age on the synthetic streams. In live replay with 1 ms arrivals, the synchronous large models cannot deliver any predictions on time while RESYNC serves at least 99.4% of arrivals within the interval, with 0.35--0.62 ms median latency on one CPU thread: around the …

item.title: Parallel Computing Systems for the Optimal Selection of Process Equipment
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

This monograph addresses the optimal selection of equipment for chemical-engineering systems of multiproduct batch plants, a large-scale NP-hard discrete optimization problem in which, for each processing stage, a unit of standard size must be chosen so that the total capital cost of the equipment is minimized while the system remains operable and produces the required products within a given time horizon. We present the mathematical model of system operation and analyze its computational properties. We then develop a sequential branch-and-bound algorithm and its parallel versions for shared-memory systems (OpenMP), distributed-memory clusters (MPI, master-worker), and graphics processing units (CUDA), including recursive and iterative tree traversal, shared-memory optimization, and branch-divergence reduction. To overcome the exponential growth of the run time, we propose a hybrid metaheuristic in which Ant Colony Optimization finds a feasible initial solution and Simulated Annealing improves it, and we implement it on GPUs with thousands of independent threads. Finally, we propose random, constant, and multi-constant approaches to tuning the parameters of the ant colony algorithm…

item.title: Paper-Faithful Federated Learning: Scientific Checks for Practitioner and Agent Development
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning experiments can produce reasonable-looking results even when the experiment implementation differs from the intended experimental protocol. Small errors in configuration, data partitioning, aggregation, randomness, evaluation, or checkpoint recovery may therefore affect a comparison without causing the program to fail. We present FedBrew, a research codebase for controlled and reproducible federated learning experiments. Its focus is controlled simulation with checks of specified conditions of the intended experimental protocol. FedBrew uses configuration checks, identifiable client data partitions, checkpoint recovery checks, self-describing run records, and development-time checks of scientific conditions. These checks assess, for example, whether client partitions are disjoint and exhaustive and aggregation weights match the prescribed rule; numerical and recovery checks examine non-finite client model states and interrupted runs. The same structure also provides clear extension points and automated checks for new algorithms, datasets, models, and tasks, whether they are added by researchers or AI coding agents. FedBrew therefore supports reproducible and insp…

item.title: PACER: GPU Excursion Management for ML Workloads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Variability is an inherent characteristic of modern GPU systems, arising from a combination of process variation, dynamic environmental conditions, and power management decisions. Prior work has characterized inter-GPU variability and found consistent performance differences across GPUs. However, we observe that modern workloads, particularly large language models (LLMs), exhibit significant intra-GPU variability. Their short-running kernels interact poorly with the coarse granularity of dynamic power management mechanisms, leading to unpredictable performance. A key source of this intra-GPU transient variability is power excursions, also referred to as electrical design power peaks (EDP$_{p}$), where power temporarily exceeds the GPU's rated power limits. While power management mechanisms are designed to ensure reliable operation despite the presence of EDP$_{p}$ sustained power peaks cause throttling that detrimentally impacts overall application performance. To the best of our knowledge, our work is the first to characterize the magnitude and frequency of EDP$_{p}$, showing that frequent, significant power overshoots are especially common in ML workloads, which combine high powe…

item.title: Overcoming Spurious Correlations in Conditional Diffusion Models via Doubly Robust Target Correction
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

While conditional diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in generation tasks, they memorize spurious correlations within training data. This causes them to deviate from ideal target distributions. Minimizing a covariate shift-adjusted target risk can address this issue. However, retraining models from scratch for different distributions is computationally prohibitive. To overcome this limitation, we propose DR-Diff, a framework that efficiently fine-tunes pre-trained conditional diffusion models. Specifically, DR-Diff leverages a functional gradient approach to derive a pseudo-target. This pseudo-target captures the residual between the base model's noise prediction and the ground-truth noise under the target distribution. Training the model to fit this pseudo-target enables efficient target adaptation. Theoretically, we prove that DR-Diff guarantees target risk reduction at the population level. It also achieves a pseudo-doubly robust property, providing resilience against density ratio estimation errors and base model misspecifications. item.title: On the Difficulty of Sequence-Level Supervised Learning for Autoregressive Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

During the supervised learning phase, autoregressive language models are typically trained by minimizing the negative log-likelihood of the training data, which decomposes as a sum of token-level cross-entropies via teacher forcing. This objective is simple and efficient but potentially suffers from so-called exposure bias: a mismatch between the way the model is trained and the way it is used at inference time. Can we instead design sequence-level loss functions that incorporate inference-time decoding procedures, such as greedy decoding or autoregressive sampling? We show that two natural attempts lead to loss functions that are fundamentally flawed: unbounded below. We further show that these two flawed loss functions are intimately connected: using autoregressive Gumbel tricks, the sampling based loss is the expected greedy loss under Gumbel perturbations. Since the pathology stems from the dependence of the decoded sequence on the model parameters, we analyze the update direction obtained by applying a stop gradient on the sampling procedure, leading to a moment matching direction. While it is not the gradient of any loss function, we prove that it defines a valid descent dire…

item.title: Near-Optimal Regret for Oracle-Efficient Adversarial Contextual Bandits
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

We study contextual bandits with $K$ actions, a class of $N$ policies, and i.i.d.\ contexts from a distribution that the learner can sample. For any sequence of loss functions fixed before play, we give an oracle-efficient algorithm with expected regret $O(\sqrt{KT\log(2N)}\,\log(2KT))$ against the best policy in hindsight on the realized contexts. This improves the $T^{2/3}$ dependence on the horizon in prior oracle-efficient bounds and achieves the optimal regret rate in this setting up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm perturbs policy scores using a Poisson sample of auxiliary contexts. At each sampled context, the perturbation assigned to an action is a Laplace noise draw multiplied by a scale specific to that context and action. We show that choosing these scales to minimize a convex objective determined by past observations yields the stated regret bound. We further approximate the minimizing scales by projected stochastic gradient descent using only an exact offline cost-sensitive optimization oracle that returns the optimum value. Since the table of scales can be large, the algorithm represents the SGD iterates implicitly by storing the random draws that determine each …

item.description:

Protein mutation effect prediction is fundamental to protein engineering and disease variant interpretation, yet experimentally measured mutation data remain accurate but extremely sparse. To provide scalable supplementary mutation signals, we construct a PDB-wide mutation augmentation dataset that exhaustively enumerates single-site substitutions on experimentally resolved protein structures and aligns mutation signals from physics-based energy models, protein language models, and inverse folding models. Large-scale analysis under a unified mutation preference representation reveals substantial differences in the consistency, concentration, and substitution patterns of mutation distributions across models, indicating that disagreement is pervasive and reflects conflicting inductive biases rather than random noise. Motivated by these observations, we propose an unsupervised multi-source mutation preference distillation framework that learns from relative mutation preferences while explicitly modeling cross-source disagreement. item.title: Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：Apple Silicon 上训练/评估生成 Metal kernel 的模型需原生 macOS 工具与并发 agent 会话，但会话在模型请求、开发命令与 GPU 执行间交替，GPU 大量空闲。

方法：Metal Sandbox 提供受限 per-instance 文件访问、原生命令执行与跨 Mac 命令级调度：并行命令并发，串行命令共享每节点执行槽，等待命令可迁移到可用 Mac 并把结果返回原 agent；集成 Harbor 支持任务执行与自动验证。

关键数字：四台 Mac mini M4 集中负载下命令吞吐 1.68x-2.05x；16 条静态 agent 轨迹估计 4 会话/节点持续吞吐增益 2.14x；动态调度降低平均工具等待 18.8%、批处理耗时 22.3%；开源。

为什么值得看：GPU coding agent 的调度基础设施，Apple Silicon 生态直接可用。

原文：Metal Sandbox: Isolated Execution and Command Scheduling for GPU Coding Agents on Apple Silicon

item.title: MegaOps: A Kernel Overlapping Framework with PyTorch-like Modularity and Megakernel Performance
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：kernel-per-operator 范式的整核依赖屏障使 SM 空闲、计算通信串行化、无法跨 kernel 预取；megakernel 融合消除屏障但牺牲模块化——能否兼得？

方法：MegaOps 把依赖 kernel 放到独立 CUDA streams，按生产者写入/消费者读取的中间张量 tile 粒度强制依赖；采用相同数据 tiling 的任何两 kernel 无需修改即可组合。

关键数字：Llama3/Qwen3 在单 H100/A100/L40 与 4xA100/8xH100 多卡评估；匹配手调 ThunderKittens megakernel 吞吐，decode 吞吐 1.09-1.10x、prefill 0.98-1.10x 对比最佳基线，且复用现成 Triton/cuBLAS/cuDNN kernel。

为什么值得看：模块化与 megakernel 性能兼得的框架设计，工程落地价值高。

原文：MegaOps: A Kernel Overlapping Framework with PyTorch-like Modularity and Megakernel Performance

item.title: Maximizing Capacity Utilization of LoRA Adapters for Mitigating the Learning-Forgetting Trade-off
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) often underperforms full fine-tuning, especially in heterogeneous and continual-learning settings in which substantial forgetting occurs. In general, it suffers from an undesirable learning-forgetting trade-off across diverse fine-tuning settings. We identify a potential contributor: LoRA adapters, especially high-rank ones, frequently fail to realize the available capacity afforded by the configured rank. Specifically, we find that standard LoRA updates have effective rank far below their configured rank, limiting how broadly the update energy is distributed. Therefore, we propose training mechanisms that optimize the original objective while maximizing adapter effective rank. Our main method adds a simple, stable, differentiable, and SVD-free Rényi-2 effective-rank regularizer to the language-modeling loss. We also connect capacity maximization to norm-bounded updates. In mixed-domain rank sweeps on three models evaluated with multiple random seeds, a penalty weight of $λ=0.01$ lowers mean Wiki perplexity at every tested rank of at least $16$ relative to unpenalized LoRA. Mean training perplexity improves or increases by at most $0.02$ in all but one mo…

item.title: Locality Meets Interference: Structure and Scheduling in Radio Multicasting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

We study multipoint-to-multipoint multicasting in synchronous radio networks with unknown participant locations and unrestricted message aggregation. Let $n$ be the network size, $k$ the number of participants, and $d$ their hop diameter. A supplied distance-two coloring with $C$ colors yields completion within $(C-1)d+1$ slots and at most $nk$ transmissions. In unit disk graphs, coordinates, one-hop neighbor data, and a common degree bound $Δ_0$ suffice for a $15(Δ_0+1)$-color schedule. A known fixed separation bound permits optimal deterministic $Θ(d)$ completion from coordinates alone. Without geometric data, strong selectivity gives $O(d\min\{n,(Δ_0+1)^2\log n\})$ slots when $n$ is known. Independent random transmission gives $O((Δ_0+1)(d+\log(k/η)))$ slots with failure probability at most $η$; for fixed $Δ_0$, this simplifies to $O(d+\log(1/η))$. A star construction shows that the logarithmic term is necessary for this random rule when the degree grows. We extend color schedules to fixed deletions and subgraphs connected over bounded windows of cycles. item.title: LoCoJAX: Host-Local Coordination for Small-Model RL on TPUs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly targets small language models, and executing these workloads efficiently across multiple accelerators requires effective coordination. On TPUs, Pathways-based RL uses a single controller to coordinate computation across hosts. This execution model is effective for large models, but its coordination computational costs are harder to amortize when small models repeatedly invoke short computations. To characterize these computational costs, we sweep dense models from 0.6B to 405B parameters on TPU v7x under a decode-heavy workload and measure how host and network computational overhead vary with model size. At 0.6B, host orchestration occupies 36% of step time and network communication 2%, whereas for large models, estimated network computational costs dominate the non-compute time. Motivated by these findings, we present Local Coordination JAX (LoCoJAX), which implements local rollout and reward processing on each TPU host with synchronous global training. In controlled comparisons against a tuned and optimized Pathways baseline on Qwen3-0.6B across three workloads and 8-64 TPU v7x chips, its colocated mode (LoCoJAX-CO) is 1.3-3.6x faster per …

item.title: Linking Rapid Learning to Compositional Structure in Neural Networks: Evidence from Additive Analogies in Meta-Learned Parameter Spaces
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Humans can learn rapidly from limited experience, while neural networks typically require extensive training. In this work, we investigate what properties of a neural network can enable it to learn rapidly. We study neural networks that have been optimized via meta-learning, a technique that exposes a network to many related functions to facilitate its subsequent learning of similar functions. Prior work has shown that these meta-learned networks can learn new functions rapidly, but how they do so remains unclear. To investigate their internal structure, we take inspiration from classic work demonstrating additive relationships among the learned vectors that neural networks use to represent words (e.g., "king" minus "man" plus "woman" approximates "queen"). Analogously, we look for additive relationships among a meta-learned network's "representations" of different functions; when a meta-learned network rapidly learns to implement a specific function, all of its adapted parameter values can be concatenated into a single vector that we treat as representing the function. item.title: LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：边缘设备内存决定能跑什么 LLM 与多快（4GB Nano 容量受限、8GB Orin Nano Super 带宽受限）；GPTQ/AWQ/K-/I-quants 对矩阵每个整数码花费等量比特，但码并不均匀。

方法：LazyWeights 保留现有格式但调整 GPTQ 使码可压缩，Huffman 无损编码交错 lane，DRAM 与 L2 间小单元按需解码；GPU kernel 不变，DRAM 只移动编码字节。

关键数字：1%/3.5% perplexity 预算下 Phi-3-mini/Mistral-7B/SmolLM-1.7B 比最佳 llama.cpp 格式小 5.7-31.4%；0.21mm² ASIC 解码器（1GHz, 7nm）削减 Orin 每 token 延迟/能耗最多 36%/38%（prompt-lookup 投机下 54%/44%）；Nano 上比 CPU llama.cpp 每 token 少 58-64% 时间、53-57% 能耗，流式 Mistral-7B 快 6.6x @ 3.89 bits/weight。

为什么值得看：边缘 LLM 内存优化的端到端方案，格式兼容 + 专用解码硬件。

原文：LazyWeights: Decode-on-Demand Edge LLMs

item.title: JudgeMix: Judge-Guided Mixed-Rollout Data Synthesis for LLM Agents
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on expert trajectories is a standard paradigm for training LLM agents. However, it suffers from a well-known training-inference distribution mismatch, calling for target-aware data synthesis strategies that ground the training data in the target model's native state distribution. To bridge this gap, emerging approaches incorporate the expert either to guide mixed rollouts alongside the target model, or to provide dense step-wise supervision. Nonetheless, existing methods apply expert assistance blind to the target model's inherent behavior: they either disrupt the rollout using sub-optimal random intervention heuristics, or they enforce indiscriminate uniform supervision that unnecessarily overwrites the model's already-correct actions. We introduce JudgeMix, a judge-guided data synthesis framework that dynamically interleaves the target model and expert based on step-wise semantic evaluations. JudgeMix queries expert guidance precisely when the target model struggles, ensuring high trajectory success rates while keeping the state distribution aligned with the target model. It additionally uses the judge evaluation to reweight expert supervision on diff…

item.title: Infrastructure for Verifiable AI: Where Proof Costs Go and How Hardware Can Help
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Users of artificial intelligence services, including those powered by large language models and other transformer-based models, need assurance that inference and training follow the declared computation without exposing private models or data. Zero-knowledge proofs can provide this assurance, but proof generation remains expensive. Hardware acceleration research often reports gains for individual cryptographic operations, leaving their effect on the full cost of proving neural-network workloads, particularly large transformer models, unclear. We introduce a four-layer framework linking verifiable AI workloads, proof systems, cryptographic kernels and hardware platforms, use it to review the literature, and add original measurements of six provers and seven kernels to identify which costs matter in practice. Our measurements show that the dominant cost changes with the proof system and input length. In low-rank fine-tuning, the cost of opening commitments to fixed model weights remains nearly constant across input lengths from 64 to 2048, while the work associated with intermediate values grows. A 13-billion-parameter fine-tuning configuration exceeds the capacity of a 40-gigabyte g…

item.title: ISLA: A Coordinate-Free, Measure-Weighted Transformer for Boundary-Driven PDEs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

A foundational principle of physics is that all coordinate systems are equally valid: the behavior of a PDE-governed system does not depend on the origin or orientation of the frame, nor on the units or mesh used to write it down, and neither should a surrogate model. Yet the neural surrogates with the lowest errors on today's aerodynamics benchmarks lack these invariances and fail under simple transformations of the same problem: for models trained on PDEs of cars in one pose (i.e., translation and rotation) and from one mesher, rotating the full PDE raises the surface-pressure error from 4% to more than 100%, and re-sampling its boundary raises it to about 30%. We introduce ISLA (Invariant Slice Attention), a slice-attention transformer for steady, boundary-driven PDEs in which no learned operation receives a coordinate and every sum over the boundary is a quadrature. Positions enter only as distances and relative angles to learned slice anchors, lengths are measured in a unit computed from the boundary, and interior points query the boundary through a tree-accelerated learned kernel without influencing one another. With every boundary cell a token and an exact boundary read, ISL…

item.title: GC-MoE on SM120: Overlapping Expert-Parallel Token Dispatch with Warp-Level FP8xFP4 Block-Scaled MMA on Consumer Blackwell
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：消费级 Blackwell（SM120, cc 12.0, RTX PRO 5000）只有 warp-level mma.sync.aligned.kind::mxf8f6f4，无 tensor memory/two-CTA MMA/cluster multicast，如何重建 expert-parallel token 分发的融合算子？

方法：swap-AB warp-level block-scaled MMA（FP4 权重在 A 寄存器、FP8 激活在 B）+ SM120 特有机理：MMA immediate 选 scale 字节、compact-weights 路径、自适应 token-tile 几何、expert 粒度流式分发（batched bulk-pull 引擎 + 64-bit 去重 pull cache）、resident relay copiers 排空 BF16 返回。

关键数字：8xRTX PRO 5000 PCIe 上比 FlashInfer CuTe DSL W4A8 MegaMoE 快 1.522x、比 Cake MegaMoE 快 1.387x（18/18 decode 点全胜）；fused shared experts 快 1.388x；94 数值案例 + 752 per-rank 检查全过，余弦相似度 ≥0.9999997。

为什么值得看：消费级 Blackwell 上 MoE decode 的极致 kernel 工程，家用卡直接受益。

原文：GC-MoE on SM120: Overlapping Expert-Parallel Token Dispatch with Warp-Level FP8xFP4 Block-Scaled MMA on Consumer Blackwell

item.title: Feature-Aware Edge Sampling for Approximate One-Step Laplacian Propagation
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

This paper studies how to approximate one-step combinatorial Laplacian messages in graph neural networks using edge sampling. We propose a spanning tree based hybrid sampler that combines feature-conditioned message scores and effective-resistance leverage scores, derive the expected one-step message error and obtain the optimal sampling probabilities and error frontier for a given expected edge budget. Preliminary experiments on synthetic community graphs show that message error decreases, while classification accuracy increases slightly, as the edge budget grows, and performance of the hybrid sampler is in between of optimal selection uniform random sampling. We leave multi-step propagation and evaluation on larger and real graphs for future work.

以上为 arXiv 摘要节选，中文省流版整理中。

item.title: Fast Serverless LLM Cold Starts by Sharing and Prewarming Startup Work
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：serverless LLM 平台按需启动模型 worker 时冷启动约 1 分钟，但仅 5-11% 花在加载权重，其余是各服务器重复执行的编译、内存剖析与运行时设置。

方法：Cairn——首个启动某模型的服务器把权重与引擎产物发布到集群共享 CXL 内存池，其余服务器原地读取；模型无关的设置在 warm containers 内提前完成，模板进程即用即替换容器。

关键数字：ServerlessLLM on vLLM v0.20，1B-14B 六模型、两服务器共享模拟 CXL 池：无自有 checkpoint 的服务器冷启动提速 4.1-5.2x，请求流中位 TTFT 降 64%。

为什么值得看：serverless LLM 冷启动的系统性优化，CXL 共享池方案可落地。

原文：Fast Serverless LLM Cold Starts by Sharing and Prewarming Startup Work

item.title: Edge-Gradient Augmentation under Reinforcement Learning for Temporal Graph
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Temporal link prediction is critical for understand- ing dynamic interactions in evolving networks, informing appli- cations ranging from social network analysis to recommendation systems. Existing methods typically rely on raw temporal graph data, often neglecting explicit edge-change information that can significantly improve predictive performance. To address this gap, we propose edge-gradient reinforced learning (EG-RL), a framework that explicitly encodes edge-gradient events (edge births and deaths) through dedicated node and link encoding modules. EG-RL uses a policy-driven reinforcement-learning mechanism to dynamically select and augment the most infor- mative edge snapshots, guided by critic-based feedback to opti- mize prediction accuracy. The model comprises distinct modules for node encoding, link encoding, token mixing, and channel mixing, integrated through global pooling and followed by a two-layer multilayer perceptron classifier. Extensive experiments on multiple dynamic graph datasets demonstrate substantial gains in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve and average precision. Ablation studies further confirm the necessity of adaptive edge-gradie…

item.title: DySR-GNN: Dynamic Sensor-Relationship Graph Neural Network for Root Cause Analysis in Automotive HiL Multivariate Time Series
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Root-cause analysis in automotive Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) systems is challenging because faults can propagate across multiple interacting signals, making the most abnormal sensor different from the actual fault origin. This work proposes DySR-GNN, a Dynamic Sensor-Relationship Graph Neural Network for supervised multi-label root-cause identification in multivariate HiL time series. The approach jointly extracts temporal patterns within individual sensor signals and structural relationships across sensors. Each sensor is processed by a shared temporal encoder and combined with a trainable sensor-identity representation, from which a sparse relationship graph is reconstructed independently for every input window. This window-specific structure provides an explicit representation of the sensor relationships used for graph message passing and direct root-location prediction. Under a recording-disjoint evaluation protocol, the proposed model outperforms CNN--LSTM, Static GCN, Static GAT, and context-based variants, achieving a recording-level Macro-F1 of 0.9524, MCC of 0.9302, and strict exact-match accuracy of 0.8519. item.title: Does Deep Knowledge Tracing Learn Semantic Relations Between Knowledge Components?
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Deep Knowledge Tracing (DKT) is a knowledge tracing (KT) model that updates a shared latent state from sequences of interactions, each pairing a knowledge component (KC) with a response. An interaction with one KC can therefore affect predictions for other KCs. We ask: Are the KC relations learned by DKT semantic? We construct text-derived semantic KC representations using nine pipelines to test whether the conclusions hold across alternative ways of constructing those representations. The first test compares DKT-derived KC relation graphs with semantic relation structures induced by pairwise cosine similarities among the KC representations. Across the evaluated datasets, embedding models, and pipelines, the two structures align only weakly and inconsistently. The second test introduces semantic information into DKT; the pretrained text-derived representations do not consistently outperform the standard DKT baseline. In the reduced-data experiments, semantic initialization yields a higher test area under the ROC curve (AUC) than the baseline at eight of nine nested sample sizes for ASSISTments 2017. KC-supervised fine-tuned BERT produces small positive AUC differences in some match…

item.title: Detection Is Not Early Warning: Evaluating Token-Level Alarms on Language Model Failures
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Many failures of language models begin at a specific token, the onset. A monitor that reads the model during generation can classify the finished response, detect the failure once it is under way, or warn before it begins, and only a warning leaves time to stop or steer the generation. Monitors are usually evaluated with response-level metrics such as AUROC, which ignore when the monitor fires. We introduce PREWARN, an evaluation protocol for any failure with an annotated onset. It calibrates each monitor's threshold on validation data to an error rate chosen for the application, runs the monitor, and scores its alarms relative to the onset on all three tasks. As a case study we apply it to repetitive degeneration in three open language models, with early warning as the main task, using linear probes on activations and six untrained baselines. Response-level metrics saturate on this failure, and a rule that reads only the response length scores almost perfectly, while probes that AUROC ranks as equal warn very differently under PREWARN. Probes warn before the onset on most degenerate responses of two of the three models, low-rank adapters below the probe more than double the share …

item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Connected health devices increasingly support health monitoring outside clinical settings, making secure and accessible physiological data important for patients and caregivers. However, device-specific applications and interfaces complicate the integration of readings from different devices. The Matter standard provides standardized device commissioning and protected communication, but its cluster library does not represent the health attribute measurement. We present a preliminary demo study of a Matter-based IoMT testbed with a specific HealthVitals cluster. Implemented in the connectedhomeip SDK on a Raspberry~Pi~5, the cluster exposes simulated heart rate, blood oxygen saturation, and body temperature. We examine commissioning, attribute retrieval, communication under simulated packet loss, and operational traffic through a reference controller. The study demonstrates that this custom telemetry model can operate within the tested Matter configuration without modifying commissioning or secure-session mechanisms. item.title: Dataset Distillation via Drifting
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

The task of dataset distillation concerns the learning of a small set of synthetic samples that can serve as an effective replacement for a large real dataset when used for downstream tasks. While many solutions have been proposed since the problem's inception, most of them primarily seek to optimize the distilled data with respect to a classifier. In this work, we propose a new distillation method that learns a set of samples such that they directly approximate the per-class data distribution. Specifically, we "drift" our distilled data in the latent space of a feature extractor such that they move both toward the real data and away from each other without using a classification objective. We find that our drifted data cover the real distribution significantly better than existing methods while still serving as powerful training samples for classification. Furthermore, we showcase our method's use as a visualization tool for better interpreting models and extend it beyond images to other modalities. Our work advances the frontier of dataset distillation, offering a novel synthesis method and proposing distribution-based metrics as a complementary evaluation. More broadly, our find…

item.title: DRAMA: Dissecting Attention Redundancy for Accelerating Multimodal Diffusion Large Language Models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Multimodal diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text through iterative masked denoising with bidirectional attention, offering a compelling alternative to autoregressive vision-language modeling. However, each denoising step requires a full forward pass over long multimodal sequences in which visual tokens dominate the sequence length, and a fixed step budget further compounds this quadratic per-step cost. Existing inference acceleration approaches for multimodal dLLMs characterize attention redundancy implicitly, motivating designs from isolated attention visualizations rather than from measurement. We close this gap with DRAMA, a training-free acceleration framework grounded in a systematic dissection of attention redundancy in multimodal dLLMs. By probing attention tensors along spatial and temporal axes, we reveal two persistent redundancy structures: (i) attention mass consistently concentrates on a sparse subset of visual tokens, and (ii) attention distributions rapidly stabilize across denoising steps after an initial formation phase. These findings motivate two complementary mechanisms: Spatial-Redundancy-Aware Visual Token Pruning (SVTP) and Sufficiency-Guided …

item.title: Control-Flow Profiling for Workload Representativeness
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Workload characterization in performance engineering often replaces expensive target executions with lower-cost proxies, including reduced datasets, miniapps, and training inputs. Such substitutions require empirical verification that the proxy faithfully exercises the target's dynamic execution behavior. This paper presents an address-keyed control-flow profiling methodology and tool suite designed to evaluate workload representativeness directly from compiled, unmodified binaries. We pair time-ordered basic-block vector (BBV) recurrence analysis with exp-branchprof, an experimental Valgrind tool that captures five orthogonal structural profile families spanning branch direction bias, four-bit global history contexts, dynamic indirect targets, function call transitions, and intraprocedural CFG edges. Our method compares weighted event distributions from two executions of the same binary. It reports support coverage, reference event-mass coverage, distribution distance, entropy-derived quantities, and phase structure, rather than claiming that a single similarity score certifies a proxy. item.title: Class-Competence Aggregation: Output-Layer Routing for Federated Multiclass DDoS Detection under Class-Concentrated Non-IID Data
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning over distributed intrusion-detection sensors naturally produces \emph{class-concentrated} non-IID data, where an entire attack class is held by a single client and absent elsewhere. We show this collapses federated averaging in a specific, localized way: the output layer holds one decision boundary per class, and when a class's aggregation weight comes overwhelmingly from clients that have never seen it, its neuron receives an active anti-signal rather than mere dilution, collapsing to zero. On CIC-DDoS2019, standard FedAvg drives the concentrated LDAP class to $0.00 \pm 0.00\%$ F1 across every seed. We propose Class-Competence Aggregation (CCA), which aggregates the output layer per class using each client's own locally reported validation F1 as the weight, while hidden layers remain under standard size-weighted FedAvg. CCA requires no server-held auxiliary data and adds only one F1 scalar per class per round beyond the feature-scaling and class-count exchanges common to any federated pipeline. On our primary CNN-LSTM architecture, CCA alone raises LDAP F1 from $0\%$ to $84.83 \pm 1.65\%$, and the full method reaches $91.64 \pm 0.57\%$ macro F1, closing the fede…

item.title: Calibration and Conformal Prediction for Medical Question Answering in Arabic and English: Evidence from Two Non-Parallel Benchmarks
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly tested on medical exam questions, but accuracy alone does not show when an answer can be trusted. I study the calibration and uncertainty of two open-weight models, Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct and Jais-adapted-7B-chat (both run in 4-bit precision), on 2,816 English multiple-choice questions from MedMCQA and 4,927 Arabic multiple-choice questions from MedAraBench. Accuracy was 0.561 (English) and 0.430 (Arabic) for Qwen, and 0.369 and 0.308 for Jais. Raw option probabilities were overconfident in all four settings (expected calibration error 0.242 to 0.486), and a single temperature parameter removed 82% to 93% of that error. Split conformal prediction reached its nominal coverage in all 24 settings I tested (within 0.006), but the sets were large when accuracy was low: at 90% coverage, temperature-scaled sets contained on average 63% (Qwen, English), 78% (Qwen, Arabic), 86% (Jais, English) and 89% (Jais, Arabic) of the options. The margin between the top two option probabilities separated correct from incorrect answers best for Qwen on English (AUROC 0.734) and worst for Jais on Arabic (0.579). item.title: Broadcast, Don't Replicate: Eliminating Weight HBM in Datacenter LLM Serving
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：数据中心 LLM serving 把只读且相同的权重复制到数万加速器本地 DRAM，资本开支、静态功耗与冗余取数能耗巨大；光环路延迟线内存方案须容纳整个模型、slack 固定且不适配 MoE。

方法：Optical Broadcast Memory (OBM)——开放式分层 Tap-and-Amplify 光纤架构：中央内存服务器持续广播权重，分布式推理节点用只收光收发器被动 tap 数据流直达计算单元；动态大小 slack 支持大/可变上下文，可高效服务 MoE。

关键数字：80,000 加速器规模评估，消除 PB 级 HBM，吞吐与每 token 能耗与 HBM 系统相当或更优。

为什么值得看：数据中心内存架构的大胆替代，光纤广播替代权重复制。

原文：Broadcast, Don't Replicate: Eliminating Weight HBM in Datacenter LLM Serving

item.title: Beyond Binary Classification: Multiclass Machine Learning for Diabetes and Prediabetes Risk Prediction Using NHANES
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Detecting diabetes risk early is important for preventing disease progression. Most existing machine learning approaches focus on binary classification, which limits their ability to capture intermediate risk states such as prediabetes. We develop a supervised learning framework to classify adults as normal, prediabetic, or diabetic using National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey data. The framework uses routinely collected demographic, clinical, and lifestyle variables from 15,356 adults, with glycated hemoglobin (HbA1c) used only to define labels and excluded from input features to prevent leakage. We compare conventional machine learning and transformer-based models and examine two binary formulations: normal versus prediabetes, and normal versus combined prediabetes and diabetes. Models are evaluated on a held-out test set using precision, sensitivity, specificity, and F1 score. In the multiclass setting, performance is broadly consistent across models, with accuracy up to 0.72 and macro-averaged F1 of 0.70. Prediabetes remains the most challenging class, with F1 scores of 0.54 to 0.56 for conventional models and 0.53 to 0.55 for transformers, reflecting its overlap with…

item.title: Bellman Contraction under MMD: A Unified Framework
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

We introduce a mathematical framework for studying contraction of the distributional Bellman operator under Maximum Mean Discrepancy (MMD). We show that contraction reduces to conditional positive definiteness of an associated kernel constructed from the base kernel, which we call the Bellman difference kernel. Focusing on radial kernels, we use Schoenberg's theorem to connect this condition to Bernstein functions. This gives contraction criteria that hold in any dimension and can be verified analytically or tested numerically. Our framework unifies known results for the Gaussian RBF, power-distance, and multiquadric kernels. A numerical search identifies 11 new kernels that induce contraction. We also propose chaining, a general construction that produces kernels inducing contraction with any prescribed factor. To reconcile theory with practice, we show that contraction on a set only requires conditional positive definiteness on that set. This explains why the RBF kernel can remain a valid choice when rewards are bounded, despite its lack of global contraction. item.title: Autonomous Mobile Robots on a Computing Field
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

We introduce CABOT, a computational model for autonomous mobile robots in which the discrete plane the robots operate on is not a passive stage but an active computing medium. In the classical Look-Compute-Move (LCM) model every increase in computational capability is obtained by strengthening the robots themselves, with lights, memory or wider visibility, at a cost paid once per robot. CABOT strengthens the environment instead: each cell of the grid holds a state from a finite set Q, the states evolve synchronously under a uniform local rule that also senses whether a robot stands on the cell, that is, the floor is a cellular automaton, and the Look operation returns the states of the visible cells in addition to the positions of the visible robots. The robots are as weak as we can make them: oblivious, silent, lightless, myopic with visibility range 1, without multiplicity detection and unable to write to the floor. The number of field states |Q|, rather than any robot capability, becomes the measure of the resources required. On an inert floor (|Q| = 1) such robots can neither form a line, nor gather from scattered positions, nor explore a grid. We show that a handful of states …

item.title: Asymmetric Multimodal Learning with Decomposed JEPAs
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Cross-modal alignment is the standard objective for building multimodal representations. We show that alignment as a \emph{sole} objective is lossy wherever modalities are informationally asymmetric---where neither can express what the other carries. Visual question answering is an obvious case: a question is a selective relational operator probing a dense visual field whose fine-grained features no query recovers, so what alignment preserves is not what the task requires. We prove an \textbf{Alignment Redundancy Bound}: alignment-only Dirichlet energy minimization retains at most the redundant information atom $\Red(Z; X_1, X_2)$, annihilating private modality-specific structure $\Unq(Z; X_m)$ and cross-modal synergy $\Syn(Z; X_1, X_2)$. We introduce \textbf{Decomposed JEPA (D-JEPA)}, which factorizes latents into an aligned shared core and private modality-specific fibers. The shared core retains most of the structure alignment targets; the private fibers recover what alignment discards, via contextual masked prediction and asymmetric cross-subspace independence. item.title: An Agentic Python Framework for LLM-Driven UVM Testbench Synthesis with Closed-Loop Compiler Feedback
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Protocol bridge verification is a persistent bottleneck in SoC development: for every new bridge instance, engineers hand-craft a full UVM testbench from scratch, consuming 40--100 engineering hours of bring-up effort. We present an agentic Python framework that generates complete, protocol-aware UVM testbenches for arbitrary IP and subsystem configurations from a structured Verification Manifest---a JSON specification encoding interface topology, protocol semantics, and coverage intent. The framework employs a dual closed-loop architecture: an inner compiler feedback loop that injects categorised UVM diagnostics rather than raw tool output, and an outer coverage loop driven by intent-gap analysis against the Manifest. Validated on the AMBA AHB-to-APB bridge---a representative production protocol bridge with a 7-state control FSM, two-phase APB handshake, and non-trivial burst serialisation logic---the framework achieves 96.8% functional coverage, a $4.7\times$ bring-up speedup, and a Protocol Verification Completeness score of 0.87, with only 2.1% of the generated 4,623-line testbench requiring human correction. Neural surrogates for computational fluid dynamics (CFD) are trained and ranked on datasets that each vary one design family in one flow domain. Such datasets cannot test the least that an aerodynamic foundation model must do: predict CFD-quality incompressible flow in seconds for new shapes in new enclosures. On DrivAerML, larger models and longer training barely lower Transolver's error; doubling the training cases cuts it by about 12% up to 400 cases, exhausting the dataset. We introduce AeroZoo, a benchmark and training corpus of 3,815 time-mean solutions to the unsteady Reynolds-averaged Navier--Stokes (RANS) equations with a transition model, across seven geometry families, eight enclosure configurations and Reynolds numbers from $10^3$ to $10^8$. Each sample poses a well-posed PDE problem in the form a solver receives it: the boundary meshes grouped by condition type, the prescribed values and the fluid properties. item.title: Accelerating Distributed Variational Quantum Computing over Wireless Networks with Incentive Mechanism Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-12　分类：论文PDF

Distributed variational quantum computing (DVQC) appears as the emerging paradigm to address the limitations of near-term quantum devices by decomposing large parameterized quantum circuits (PQCs) into smaller subcircuits executed across multiple quantum processors. In this context, how to incentivize quantum processors to participate actively is crucial for accelerating DVQC, yet remains largely unexplored in the literature. To address this significant gap, we propose a novel two-stage incentive framework for wireless DVQC. In the first stage, we minimize processor-side energy cost via a joint optimization of subcircuit parameters, number of noise measurements, and transmit power, efficiently solved using block coordinate descent (BCD) and successive convex approximation (SCA). In the second stage, we maximize aggregator-side system utility by selecting an optimal subset of processors based on their optimized energy costs derived from the first stage, formulating a non-convex combinatorial selection problem addressed using the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM). Extensive numerical experiments on the MNIST and CIFAR-10 datasets demonstrate that our DVQC framework a…

item.title: What Conformal Selection Can Certify in CRISPR Off-Target Design:Benchmark Leakage, Free Baselines, and a Finite-Sample Cohort Requirement
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF

Conformal selection promises distribution-free, finite-sample control of the error rate of a decision, and has been proposed as a safety layer for machine-learning CRISPR guide design. We ask whether such a certificate is attainable from the validated off-target data that exist. The constraint is arithmetic: a conformal p-value cannot fall below one divided by the calibration cohort size plus one, so a Benjamini-Hochberg selection certifies a single candidate only when that cohort is at least the candidate pool size divided by the tolerated error rate. Public cohorts supply ten validated guides, whereas a pool of two thousand at a ten percent error rate needs twenty thousand; the accepted set is consequently empty in over ninety-six percent of splits. Two benchmarking findings explain why this went unnoticed. item.description:

The micro-Doppler (uD) spectrum provides detailed characteristics of target movement, making it highly valuable for applications such as target classification and human activity recognition. However, traditional Integrated Sensing And Communication (ISAC) systems are highly view-dependent and limited by blind spots and angle dependencies. Existing approaches rely on either configuration-specific solutions or data-driven models. The former results in poor generalization when device deployments or target orientations change, while the latter requires acquiring extensive multi-view datasets, which is time-consuming and not always feasible. To address these limitations, in this work we propose VISTA, a novel method for reconstructing the uD spectrogram in an absolute coordinate frame, yielding view-independent Doppler features that are invariant to the spatial distribution of ISAC nodes. We formulate the uD estimation as a sparse reconstruction problem that jointly leverages measurements from all ISAC receivers. item.title: Towards Runtime-Aware Observability for Java Virtual Threads
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.PF　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF

OS-level observability tools join application requests to kernel events through the OS thread ID, assuming that a unit of work occupies one OS thread until it completes. Java virtual threads break this assumption: many virtual threads are multiplexed onto a few carrier threads, so a stable thread ID hides a changing unit of work, and the join fails silently. Existing virtual-thread-aware channels republish context or identity on every mount and unmount, and the JVMTI-based one pays this cost for the lifetime of the JVM, whether or not an observer is attached. item.title: Tokenized Reward Systems for Federated Learning: The Privacy vs. Fairness Tradeoff
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF

Federated learning (FL) systems increasingly rely on blockchain based reward mechanisms to incentivize participation while preserving data privacy. We design and empirically evaluate two complementary Solidity smart contracts for FL reward distribution: the first one that allocates rewards proportionally to a publicly disclosed quality score, and a privacy preserving variant that hides individual quality scores behind a zero-knowledge (ZK) proof of a threshold condition. Both contracts mint a non transferable, use-and-burn token maintaining a trustless incentive structure. We evaluate the two designs through MNIST training with adversarial behavior, including Sybil attacks, zero gradient and random noise, across three independent random seeds. Our results reveal a fundamental tradeoff between cryptographic privacy and incentive fairness. The privacy preserving architecture strictly degrades system robustness, doubling the adversary's average reward capture while introducing severe outcome variance. item.title: The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison: Engine, restart, batch and kernel drift, measured against 8-bit and 4-bit effects in two decision models
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：量化模型通常与 BF16 原版对比，但该对比同时改变了引擎、服务器实例、批处理与 kernel 选择——非量化因素的决策漂移有多大？

方法：Cloudflare Clef-flash (9B)/Clef (27B) 两决策模型、2,400 条公开决策、NVIDIA GB10，逐一测量各噪声源并把量化效应表述为其超额。

关键数字：非量化来源移动 0-0.92% 决策；llama.cpp 重启逐记录比特一致；vLLM 重启翻转 0-22；引擎变更 6-16、批大小 8-15；单引擎内量化移动更多（Q8_0 0.88%/1.04%、FP8 2.12%/1.62%、NVFP4 5.79%/5.67%）；完整 31,275 问题上 Clef Q4_K_M 准确率净变 6 题；5 个预注册预测 2 个失败。

为什么值得看：量化对比方法学基准，量化评估的「噪声底」实测，避免误把非量化漂移当量化收益。

原文：The Noise Floor of a Quantization Comparison

item.title: The Illusion of Diversity: Aligning LLM Exploration via Effective Entropy
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF

Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has shifted the alignment paradigm of large language models from subjective preference to objective correctness, yet a fundamental disconnect persists between exploration diversity and reasoning validity. Existing strategies predominantly rely on "blind" entropy metrics, e.g., token-level or global sequence-level entropy, which structurally fail to distinguish between effective reasoning and potential hallucinations. This misalignment creates an illusion of diversity, where high entropy tends to signal chaotic degeneration rather than valuable exploration. To bridge this gap, we introduce Effective Entropy, a validity-aware entropy concept that quantifies diversity exclusively within the valid subspace and systematically filters out the noise of incorrect trajectories. Built on this concept, we instantiate VEPO, a simple Validity-aware Entropy Policy Optimization method that directly incorporates effective entropy into RLVR training. VEPO induces an adaptive attraction dynamic that drives up the probability of under-explored valid trajectories, a mechanism that matches the practical regime of large-scale autoregressive models where seq…

item.title: TQIR: Trellis Quantization with Integer Reconstruction for Bandwidth-Efficient Edge LLM Acceleration
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：自回归 LLM 推理受外存带宽限制，现有超低位 trellis 量化把权重重构为浮点，运行时 Hadamard 变换与解码器成本未解决。

方法：TQIR 算法-硬件协同设计，解耦存储精度 S 与解码权重 W/激活 A 计算精度；离线 trellis 匹配限制为 INT8/INT4 codeword 可精确复现整数 GEMM；逆 Hadamard 变换移到激活侧 + H128 Subspace Hadamard Transform + 128×2 trellis tile。

关键数字：TSMC 16nm 解码器 307.2 Gweights/s @ 0.0509mm²；归一化解码器面积效率为 Ecco 的 13.93x、Codeword Decomposition 的 1.52x。

为什么值得看：固定速率 trellis 压缩 + 整数 GEMM 通路，带宽受限边缘推理的硬件方案。

原文：TQIR: Trellis Quantization with Integer Reconstruction for Bandwidth-Efficient Edge LLM Acceleration

item.title: Subsurface schematisation from sparse CPT data using the tabular foundation model TabPFN
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.LG　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF

Subsurface schematisation supports geotechnical decisions but remains challenging because sparse site-investigation data leave substantial gaps in information about ground conditions. This study explores TabPFN, a foundation model pretrained on general synthetic tabular data, for this task. Using only grid coordinates and soil behaviour type index observations from sparse cone penetration tests (CPTs), we first reconstruct two-dimensional sections without geotechnical fine-tuning or predefined layer boundaries. We evaluate the approach on synthetic sections and at two field sites in the Netherlands, comparing it with SchemaGAN, a conditional generative adversarial network trained on synthetic geotechnical sections, and with reference interpolation methods. In the baseline comparisons, TabPFN achieved mean errors close to SchemaGAN's on synthetic sections and lower mean errors at both field sites. On synthetic sections, TabPFN's mean absolute error decreased at each tested increase in CPT count, and, under the baseline input setting, its pointwise prediction intervals had mean coverage close to nominal levels. Subsequent fine-tuning on the synthetic sections used to train SchemaGAN …

item.title: SubGPU Pipelining: Intra-GPU Fine-Grained Spatial Parallelism for LLM Inference
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：LLM decode 由短、内存受限 kernel 主导，突发占用片上执行资源与带宽，如何实现 GPU 内细粒度空间并行？

方法：SubGPU Pipelining 把算子图切成有序连续段，绑定到不相交 SM 池作为空间级流水线，流式 microbatches；用共享资源模拟器搜索 Pareto 前沿 + 单 B200 硅片实验模拟 32-GPU 部署。

关键数字：匹配 per-GPU 吞吐下 per-user 吞吐最高 2.2x；匹配 per-user 吞吐下 per-GPU 吞吐最高 1.9x；硅片实验 DRAM 读写吞吐从峰值 71.8% 提至 83.6%，36 层 decoder 迭代时间降 10.33%。

为什么值得看：GPU 内空间流水新模型，直接缓解 decode 内存瓶颈。

原文：SubGPU Pipelining: Intra-GPU Fine-Grained Spatial Parallelism for LLM Inference

item.title: Sub-100KB On-Device CNN Training via Dynamic Sparse Updates and Hardware--Software Co-Design
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.AR　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：端侧设备训练受内存与计算成本限制，如何把 CNN 训练压进 sub-100KB 片上 SRAM？

方法：动态稀疏更新机制（随机通道策略免评估地选择性更新重要参数）+ 激活剪枝；融合前向数据流并发处理组归一化与卷积，配合计算重排与零跳过。

关键数字：激活存储降至原 3.4%；TSMC 28nm FP8 @ 800MHz，8 TOPS 峰值、31.13 TOPS/W、14.8 TOPS/mm²；功耗 257-272mW；训练时间减 45%；片上 SRAM 95KB。

为什么值得看：端侧训练硬件极限压缩的完整案例，稀疏更新 + 软硬件协同设计。

原文：Sub-100KB On-Device CNN Training via Dynamic Sparse Updates and Hardware-Software Co-Design

item.title: Starscream: Reimagining LLM Sharding on AMD Instinct GPUs with GPU Partitioning
item.description:
发表方：arXiv cs.DC　发布：2026-11-11　分类：论文PDF / 每日精选

研究问题：chiplet 多 die GPU（如 MI300X）NUMA 特性突出，现有面向同构拓扑的 LLM 分片策略在 GPU 分区下出现内存冗余、算术强度崩塌与 flat collectives 通信开销。

方法：Starscream 沿正交维度增加 intra-GPU sharding，基于三条原则：kernel shape 保持、内存冗余消除、通信开销最小化；以 tensor parallelism 为案例验证，原则可推广到任意分片策略。

关键数字：MI300X/MI355X 上利用分区能力，attention 最高加速 4x、fused GEMM 1.43x（对比 chiplet-oblivious 基线）。

为什么值得看：chiplet 时代的 LLM sharding 范式重设计，对未来多 die 架构有指导意义。

原文：Starscream: Reimagining LLM Sharding on AMD Instinct GPUs with GPU Partitioning
